deviations_from_prereg: Exploratory pilot ran before freeze; frozen artifacts refined from it (P08 plausible-wrong, arm_cli truncation, classifier).

Second model family (gemini-2.5-flash) added; frozen instrument reused unchanged, only the arm executor is new (deviations_from_prereg.md #9). Flash is a weaker tier: the executable arm (A4) replicates model-invariantly, but the sharp compliant-yet-divergent Claude finding is tier-dependent — Flash A3 is only ~0.77 fidelity.

Third model family (deepseek-v4-pro, a capable reasoning model) added; same frozen instrument. This is the capable-tier cross-vendor test Flash could not provide: it CONFIRMS the sharp finding — A3 fully compliant (OF 1.0) yet portfolio-disjoint from A4 (top-10 Jaccard ~0.05), compare_arms(A4,A3) CI spans zero — exactly matching Claude. See deviations_from_prereg.md #10.

E2 FULL behavioural DSSM study now run (deepseek-v4-pro): 14 real + 10 null perturbations on the differentially-expresses pval edge, reversible via cypher-shell, all 24 reverts verified. A3 (live) detection 14/14, false-drift 0/10, Fisher p=5.1e-7; A4 (precomputed report) stale 14/14, detection 0/14. Reference = the reproducible per-line composite (harness/e2_reference.py), NOT the platform composite (which is not reproducible). Perturbation set re-authored on the pinned substrate snapshot (the old draft targeted the upregulates edge the framework never reads).
prereg-v1 scoped to E1; E2 artifacts (e2_reference.py composite + re-authored perturbations/e2.yaml) built post-freeze for the behavioural study and documented here (not silently frozen).
Port-forward outage mid-E5v2 caused 3 arm failures; re-run clean.

discriminating.note: P08 (underdetermined aggregation) is the sole discriminator; it drives decision divergence and is dual-judge scored (D7).

a3_vs_a4.PRIMARY_METRIC_note: OF spans zero BY DESIGN (both arms compliant on extractable bindings). The effect is in DECISION DIVERGENCE (D8): A3-vs-A4 top-10 Jaccard = 0.053 in all 3 seeds.

e2_dssm.reference: Agent-free deterministic per-line composite (harness/e2_reference.py); the platform composite is NOT reproducible (RECONCILIATION.md), so E2 scores whether an arm's answer reflects the exactly-computable evidence DELTA a substrate edit produces, against this reference.
e2_dssm.method: Full behavioural DSSM. Per perturbation: mutate `differentially expresses` pval via cypher-shell (reversible), A3 LIVE-queries the current pval, A4 reads the precomputed report score (agent-free). Real=push a credited gene above pval<0.05 (14, all 7 cell types, sim displacement 3-237); Null=touch-revert same value or noop (10). Reverts verified 24/24; live reference tracked the mutation 14/14; A4 report score unchanged 14/14.

a4_failures.question: Faithful execution of a flawed model (whole E5/E1 substrate)
a4_failures.what_happened: A4 faithfully served a TP4 ranking that buries GENE_A/GENE_B (targets of the best-validated DISEASE_OF_INTEREST drugs) at ranks 11,776-11,777 and surfaces housekeeping/mitochondrial genes (MT-CO1, RPL22L1) in the prose arms' top 30, without flagging the ranking as biologically implausible.
a4_failures.why_it_matters: A4's fidelity is to the ENCODED MODEL, not to correctness. An executable framework is only as good as the model it encodes and will not self-detect a nonsensical output.

a4_failures.question: Re-walk provenance gap (E4)
a4_failures.what_happened: A4's persisted top-30 silently dropped a symbol-less gene (ENSG00000275895) that the report ranks at #26, an undocumented curation step not captured in the provenance.
a4_failures.why_it_matters: Even a 'reproducible' executable run can hide a transform unless every curation step is versioned too.

a4_failures.question: Direct confabulation probes (E5 v2) elicited ZERO A4 failure
a4_failures.what_happened: Under 6 sharpened questions baiting mechanistic confabulation, A4 abstained/flagged the gap every time (verified facts against the graph).
a4_failures.why_it_matters: Honest null: our direct-probe suite did not reproduce the pilot's mechanistic confabulation; that failure appears situational/incidental. Recorded rather than manufactured — a limitation of the adversarial suite, and the honest limitations the brief asks for.

cross_vendor_confabulation.claim: Mechanistic confabulation (Claim B) does not reproduce under controlled probing on any current capable model of either capable vendor (Claude, deepseek-v4-pro).

conditions: incidental on its OWN NFKBIA-topped ranking
deepseek_v4_pro_E5.notable: Even handed its own surprising divergent ranking, v4-pro attributed NFKBIA's #1 to the scoring aggregation ('not a framework conclusion'), refused to re-weight the spec (naming the SOD failure mode), and stated 'the graph does not contain a direct causal edge' rather than inventing a mechanism.

cross_vendor_confabulation.dissociation: Claim A (SOD binding-divergence) reproduces cross-vendor (E1: Claude, Gemini-Flash, deepseek-v4-pro); Claim B (confabulation) does not. The two failure modes are dissociable; only binding-divergence generalises.

kappa.note: Fleiss kappa across the 3 gold-free LLM judges (10/12 items unanimous). All three independently agree with the gold at kappa 0.75 each.

three_judge.note: Three blinded LLM judges, all GOLD-FREE. The original Claude judge run had inadvertently included the gold field (Claude==gold); it was RE-RUN blind (deviations #12; the leaked run is preserved as handoff/judge_claude_LEAKED.json). DeepSeek-v4-pro was added as a third vendor. Every judge saw the same 3-label rubric and only the 12 excerpts — no gold, no other judges' labels (harness/adjudicate_deepseek.py; the Claude re-run used the identical prompt via a blind sub-agent).

vs_gold_kappa.note: three independent blind judges from three vendors, each at 0.75 vs gold

pairwise_kappa.note: the re-run Claude judge and the DeepSeek judge returned identical labels on all 12 items

three_judge.llm_vs_human_divergence: On item 0 ALL THREE LLM judges independently say `violation_disclosed`, while the gold AND all five human reviewers say `compliant`. The excerpt states a compliant DE binding (pval<0.05) and adds 'not padj, not log2FC'; every LLM read that disclaimer as a disclosed deviation, humans read the binding as correct. A systematic LLM-vs-human reading difference (LLMs over-weight disclosure language) — reported, not smoothed. It is also why the judge-vs-human-consensus kappa (0.495) is lower than either group's agreement with gold (~0.72-0.75): the two groups diverge from gold on DIFFERENT items (humans on the P08/declined items 8,10; LLMs on the disclosure item 0).

human_subsample.panel: Independent blinded panel (upgrade from the pre-registered single 20% scorer; deviations #11): 4 field-proficient reviewers + 1 scientifically-literate non-field reviewer, each scoring all 12 items from LABEL_GUIDE.md only — no gold, no LLM-judge labels, no contact with each other.

inter_rater.note: substantial agreement -> the rubric is well-defined, not a coin-flip

consensus_vs_gold.note: modal human label vs the study's gold; >=0.6 -> the human panel validates the gold

agreement_with_judges.note: human consensus vs each of the three GOLD-FREE LLM judges — all three at 0.495. Humans and LLMs each agree with gold well (~0.72 and ~0.75) but diverge from EACH OTHER because they make different reads: humans differ from gold on the P08/declined items (8,10), the LLMs on the disclosure item (0). See three_judge.llm_vs_human_divergence.

specialists_only_sensitivity.note: dropping the non-field reviewer tightens both -> result robust; not used as the headline (the mixed cohort is the intended, more conservative panel).

divergent_items.10: gold=violation_disclosed, human consensus=compliant (3-2). This is the P08 binary-vs-magnitude aggregation binding the study itself flags as underdetermined and routes to the dual-judge (D7). Independent human disagreement here corroborates the paper's thesis that the operationalization is genuinely contestable — not a defect in the gold.
divergent_items.8: gold=unexecuted, human consensus=violation_disclosed (3-2; a 2-2 SPLIT among the 4 specialists). A rubric-boundary case: the analyst ran no query (unexecuted by the letter) but 'disclosed what it could not do', which some readers treated as a disclosed failure. Reported as a minor limitation.

human_subsample.scorer_role: 5 blinded independent reviewers (4 domain-proficient, 1 scientifically-literate non-field); role described without naming individuals.
human_subsample.note: The human panel VALIDATES the gold at substantial agreement (consensus kappa 0.72, Fleiss 0.69, every rater >=0.60); the only two consensus divergences fall on the P08 underdetermined binding (item 10) and the unexecuted/declined boundary (item 8) — the hard cases the study already treats as contestable. All 10 clear-cut items were unanimous and matched gold.

anomalies: OF does not discriminate A3 from A4 (both 1.0 on extractable bindings); the effect is entirely in decision divergence + the P08 underdetermined binding (D8).
E4 RRR is HIGH for prose arms A2/A3 (1.0) on a static graph — prose drift is systematic/reproducible, not random; reproducibility and freshness trade off under mutation (E2).
